text: personal-track 是 DSH 网页端习惯看板，在主区域注册打卡面板并提供侧栏入口。它通过宿主 API 管理日常习惯、饮食、学习和运动记录，也能追踪任务与影视书籍；统计视图汇总完成度、连续天数和活动数据，专注模式支持笔记与素材。适合希望把每日习惯和待办集中记录的人，按需设置习惯日时区及默认目标。

personal-track is a DSH web habit board with a main panel for daily check-ins, statistics, tasks, and media. Its focus mode supports notes and materials, and users can export or import records as JSON. Optional settings control the habit-day boundary and default targets.
想把每天的习惯打卡和待办放在同一个看板里。
有没有能记录饮食、学习和运动进度的 DSH 面板？
我想按天查看习惯完成情况和连续记录。
需要给任务记进度、截止日期和专注时长。
想把书和电影也作为个人记录追踪。
能不能给习惯记录导出备份，换环境后再导入？
I want one place to track daily habits, meals, and workouts.
Can I review my streaks and completion statistics by date?
I need a focus workspace for tasks with notes and attached materials.
How can I keep a portable backup of my habit records?
习惯打卡与活动记录：看板可记录洗漱、饮食、词汇、多邻国及多种训练数据，并按习惯日查看完成进度。用户在面板操作，浏览器通过宿主 API 保存记录。
统计视图：按日期范围汇总每日完成情况、习惯比例与连续天数，并统计学习、训练、任务和媒体记录。用户切换到统计页查看聚合结果。
专注模式：打开任务或媒体条目后可记录专注会话、备注与 Markdown 或图片素材；离开时结束会话并汇总时长。
备份导入导出：用户可导出习惯域记录为 JSON，再选择合并或替换方式导入；导入内容先按格式校验。
personal-track 将习惯与条目记录保存在 DSH 的 habit 存储域，并提供 JSON 备份导入导出；源码没有配置外部账户或 API Key。

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 写的一个习惯看板：一个主面板，
左手边**专注栏**，中间**当日打卡**与**统计**；点开任务或影视书籍就是全屏的**专注模式**（笔记 + 素材）。界面跟随外壳语言（中文 / English），切换即时生效。

| 打卡 | 统计 |
|---|---|
|  |  |

@ds-hu/personal-track README · 它管什么：| 分组 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 日常 | 洗漱 ×2、洗澡、洗衣（存量 ±1 与「洗完」会话分开记） |
| 饮食 | 早饭 / 午饭 / 晚饭：点一下盖时间戳，可改时间与价格 |
| 学习 | 背单词（按当日目标、加权进度，复习词按 1/5 计）、多邻国（任意节数） |
| 健身 | 跑步（配速派生）、跳绳（次数自由、节奏派生）、引体向上、平板支撑、健身器材、自由锻炼 |
| 记录 | 影视书籍（三态 + 评分）、任务（进度 → 三态 + 逾期，可拖进度条，带检查点） |

**完成条是分数的，不是复选框**：九个习惯格之外，当日到期的任务各占一格，所以读数是 `5.3/10` 这样的小数；
每格按自己的分数渐变填绿，悬停给出百分比。「健身」是**存在格**——任一训练有记录就填满，所以休息日读 `8/9`。

@ds-hu/personal-track README · 它管什么：**专注模式**是整屏的不透明工作面：左侧名称/截止/累计专注/笔记，右上一条细工具条（进度条可拖、可 ±、
检查点可点），右下是**素材**流（Markdown 文本块 + 图片，粘贴或拖入即加）。进即开始一段**专注会话**，出即结束；
时长只由起止时刻派生，崩掉的未闭合会话不计。

**专注栏**是派生的：显示全部条目里已闭合会话中开始最晚的那一段，不存、不记浏览器本地，
所以刷新、换标签页、删掉条目之后它都与历史一致；它也没有 ×——换一张的办法是去专注别的条目。

**复制纯文本报告**把正在看的一天折成几行贴得进聊天：完成度、每组习惯一行，末尾是任务列表
（全部未完成 + 当日及以后截止的已完成，每条都写截止日 `M-D`，逾期注明，已完成行末 `✓`）。

@ds-hu/personal-track README · 安装：> **推荐用法：fork 一份，让 DSH 自己改，再 `link:` 装上。**
>
> 每个人的习惯表都不一样，而这个插件的「可配置面」是**故意**小的：四个字段走 `Config`，其余全在代码里。
> 把习惯、分组、统计卡做成界面上的枚举开关，只会让界面越来越杂，而且永远列不全——八个计数器、
> 五种会话、谁和谁合成一格，都是会变的判断。在 DSH 里改自己 fork 的那份比加开关便宜：
> 让 agent 先读 [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md) 与 [CONTEXT.md](./CONTEXT.md)，它就照本仓库自己的规矩改，
> 改完跑一遍 `pnpm test` 就知道有没有把别处弄坏。所以**不要**原样装上再找「配置习惯」的开关（没有）——
> fork 之后改成自己的作息，用下面的方式 A 装上。


只有四个字段走配置（写在 `cordis.yml`，不改代码就能调）：
| 字段 | 默认 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `dayStartHour` | `4` | 习惯日起点；00:00–04:00 归前一晚 |
| `timezone` | 本机时区 | 固定时区覆盖 |
| `defaultVocabTarget` | `{ new: 20, review: 60 }` | 无历史目标可继承时的背单词目标 |
| `defaultRunMinutes` | `30` | 新跑步记录的默认时长 |

@ds-hu/personal-track README · 数据：`~/.dsh/storages/habit/`，人类可读的 JSON，per-record 布局：
`days/<日期>.json`（一个习惯日）、`counters/laundry.json`（待洗存量）、
`media/<id>.json`、`tasks/<id>.json`（登记条目）、`assets/<id>.json`（素材图片字节）。
**空白天不产生文档**；只存事实，格数、比率、连续、逾期、专注时长都是读的时候派生的。

**备份**：统计视图的「导出」得到 `personal-track-<日期>.json`（格式 `personal-track/backup`，版本 3），
只含事实——导入后重算一切派生值，所以文件里不可能出现与数据矛盾的字段。v1 / v2 仍可导入；反向不行
（旧的构建会整份拒绝它不认识的版本）。「选择备份…」只解析并显示条数，此时还没写入；随后选**合并**
（同键覆盖）或**覆盖**（额外删掉文件里没有的本地记录），整份先按同一套 schema 校验，任何一条不合法即整份拒绝。

@ds-hu/personal-track README · personal-track：A habit board for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness):
one main panel — the **focus column** on the left, the day's **check-ins** and the
**statistics** in the middle — and, on clicking a task or a film/book, a full-screen
**focus mode** with notes and Markdown/image materials. The interface follows the
shell's language (English / 中文).

| Check-in | Statistics |
|---|---|
|  |  |

@ds-hu/personal-track README · What it tracks：| Group | Habits |
|---|---|
| Daily | Washing up ×2, shower, laundry (a stock gauge and a wash session are separate records) |
| Meals | Breakfast / lunch / dinner: one tap stamps the time, editable with a price |
| Study | Vocabulary (weighted against the day's target; a review word counts a fifth of a new one), Duolingo (any number of lessons) |
| Training | Run (pace derived), jump rope (free count, tempo derived), pull-ups, plank, gym equipment, free-form training |
| Records | Films and books (three states + rating), tasks (progress → three states + overdue, draggable bar, checkpoints) |

@ds-hu/personal-track README · What it tracks：**The completion bar is fractional, not a row of checkboxes.** Beyond the nine habit
cells, every task due that day takes a cell of its own, so a reading looks like
`5.3/10`; each cell fills with green in proportion to its own fraction and shows the
percentage on hover. Training is a **presence cell** — a run, a rope session, a set of
pull-ups, a plank, a machine or a free session fills it — so a rest day reads `8/9`
rather than full.

@ds-hu/personal-track README · What it tracks：**The focus column is derived**: it shows the closed session with the latest start
across every entry — nothing stored, nothing in browser storage — so a reload, another
tab or a deleted entry all answer the same way. It has no ×: to change the card, focus on
something else.

@ds-hu/personal-track README · What it tracks：**Copy as plain text** flattens the day you are looking at into a few lines that paste
into a chat: the completion figure, one line per group, then the task list (everything
unfinished plus anything finished with a deadline today or later, each with its
`M-D` deadline, overdue marked, finished items ending in `✓`).

@ds-hu/personal-track README · Install：> **Recommended: fork it, let DSH edit the fork, then install it with `link:`.**
>
> Everyone's habit list differs, and this plugin's configurable surface is *deliberately*
> small: four fields go through `Config`, everything else is code. Turning habits,
> groups and statistic cards into enum switches in the UI would only make the interface
> noisier, and it would still never be exhaustive — eight counters, five session kinds
> and which cells merge into one habit are all judgements that keep changing. Editing
> your own fork through DSH is cheaper than adding switches: point the agent at
> [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md) and [CONTEXT.md](./CONTEXT.md) and it will follow this
> repo's own rules; run `pnpm test` afterwards to see what it broke.
>
> So do not install it as-is looking for a "configure habits" switch (there is none).
> Fork it, change it to your own routine, and install it with option A.

dsh --profile web --dump-config        # should show the "# == @ds-hu/personal-track" layer
section: A — local (recommended): link skips packing and pnpm's build approval

text: @ds-hu/personal-track README · B — from GitHub: the repo carries source only; lib/ is built by `prepare` at install time：dsh plugin --profile web add github:ds-hu/dsh-personal-track
section: B — from GitHub: the repo carries source only; lib/ is built by `prepare` at install time

@ds-hu/personal-track README · C — try it without installing：| Field | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `dayStartHour` | `4` | Where the habit day starts; 00:00–04:00 belongs to the previous evening |
| `timezone` | the machine's | Fixed time-zone override |
| `defaultVocabTarget` | `{ new: 20, review: 60 }` | Vocabulary target when nothing historical can be inherited |
| `defaultRunMinutes` | `30` | Default duration of a new run |

@ds-hu/personal-track README · C — try it without installing：Everything else lives in the source: how a cell counts as met is
`src/host/derive.ts`, the groups and cards are `src/client/board/BoardBody.tsx`,
and every word the interface says is `src/client/copy/table.ts`.
See the **习惯清单** entry in [CONTEXT.md](./CONTEXT.md) and [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md).

@ds-hu/personal-track README · Data：`~/.dsh/storages/habit/`, human-readable JSON, one record per file:
`days/<date>.json` (one habit day), `counters/laundry.json` (the stock),
`media/<id>.json`, `tasks/<id>.json` (registry entries), `assets/<id>.json`
(material image bytes). **An empty day produces no document**, and only facts are
stored — cell counts, ratios, streaks, overdue marks and focus totals are all derived
on read.

@ds-hu/personal-track README · Data：**Backup**: "Export" in the statistics view writes `personal-track-<date>.json`
(format `personal-track/backup`, version 3) holding facts only, so the file cannot
contradict the data it came from. v1 and v2 files still import; the other direction does
not (an older build rejects a version it does not know rather than dropping fields).
Picking a file only parses it and shows the counts — nothing is written until you choose
**merge** (same keys overwrite) or **replace** (also deletes local records the file omits).
The whole file is validated against one schema first, and one bad record rejects it all.

@ds-hu/personal-track README · Development：```powershell
pnpm install     # installs dependencies; `prepare` also builds
pnpm build       # lib/index.js (host) + lib/client.js (browser closure factory)
pnpm test        # runs tests/*.test.ts one file per process
pnpm typecheck   # three separate programs: host / browser / tests

@ds-hu/personal-track README · Layout：```
src/shared/   pure rules both halves share: the route table, habit-day arithmetic,
              focus sessions, rope merging
src/host/     zod domain + derivation + store access + routes + stats + backup
src/client/   api (the command face) · copy/ (every word the panel says) · board/

The icon is `icon.svg` (a completion ring); the Plugins panel's title and one-liner come
from `locale/{zh,en}.json`.
